note: Every hook payload Skyboy understands, with the event it must produce. This file is the single source of truth for both packages/protocol/tests/samples.rs and scripts/e2e/hook-to-core.mjs, so an expectation cannot drift between them. Field names and delivery mechanisms were verified against the agents' own documentation and source on 2026-11-21; see docs/hooks.md.

delivery.codex: json appended as the final argv element

cases.note: The turn ended and Claude is waiting for a prompt.
A subagent finished; mapped to finished because the user cannot tell the difference.
The immediate permission signal; the notification route is delayed.
Slower fallback: fires about six seconds after the request.
Fires roughly a minute after the turn ends, only if the user has not typed.
A background agent is blocked on an answer.
The only immediate needs-input signal: PreToolUse matched on AskUserQuestion.
A turn that ended in an API error rather than an answer.
A tool failed for a real reason.
A user interrupt is deliberate, so it must not alert.
Ordinary tool use is not a signal.
A session starting is not worth an alert.
A notification type with no rule must be ignored, not alerted on.

The only event Codex notify produces. One compact line, which is what Codex's serde serialiser emits; the argv path also tolerates surrounding whitespace, and that is covered by a unit test rather than by this file.
